== Summary ==
Partial slip “•You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III)” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 300 dpi. Recorded with version [[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2): cut from that card image, with the same words; a slip that reprints a card image is recorded with that version, not as a separate version. Not a recreation.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/86/VD-D-youcannothideforever-2024-08-02-kit-slip.png Internet Archive item].
